drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find our initial revisions for discussion, subject to client approval. We have clarified payment and simultaneous closing mechanics and proposed qualifications to the financial-statement representation and indemnity. The purchase price, liability cap, and claims period remain open; bracketed terms must be resolved before execution. Please provide your proposed commercial terms and identify any required closing conditions.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [PURCHASE PRICE TO BE AGREED] for the Shares at Closing, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller in writing. Any purchase price adjustment must be expressly agreed in writing by the parties.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing, on a date mutually agreed by the parties, subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the applicable party of the closing conditions expressly set out in this Agreement. Payment of the Purchase Price and delivery of the instruments transferring the Shares shall occur concurrently.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. Except as expressly disclosed in the disclosure schedules delivered to the Buyer before signing, the Seller represents that the financial statements identified in those schedules fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the business for the periods covered, in accordance with [ACCOUNTING STANDARD TO BE AGREED], consistently applied, subject to any exceptions expressly identified in those schedules.

4. INDEMNITY. Subject to the limitations of this Agreement, the Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for actual, direct losses arising from liabilities of the business existing before Closing that were neither reflected or reserved for in the financial statements nor expressly disclosed in the disclosure schedules delivered before signing. The Seller's aggregate liability under this clause shall not exceed [CAP TO BE AGREED], and claims must be notified in writing with reasonable particulars within [CLAIMS PERIOD TO BE AGREED] after Closing. The Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate its losses and shall not recover more than once for the same loss. Procedures for third-party claims and any exceptions to these limitations remain to be agreed.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Seller proposes the attached counterdraft, subject to client approval. We cannot accept verified net tangible asset value as the sole pricing basis; the price and any adjustment mechanism must be expressly agreed. We have incorporated objective closing protections and indemnity for representation and covenant breaches. Our counterproposal is a 30% general indemnity cap and a 24-month general claims period, with separate treatment for title, authority, pre-Closing taxes and Seller’s fraud. Buyer will retain consent rights over settlements affecting it. Please confirm the remaining commercial points, accounting standard and disclosure schedules so the agreement can be finalized.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD [PURCHASE PRICE TO BE AGREED] for the Shares at Closing, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller in writing. Verified closing net tangible asset value shall not, by itself, determine the Purchase Price. Any adjustment must be expressly agreed in writing before signing and must specify the applicable accounting principles, calculation methodology, preparation and review timetable, and independent-accountant dispute resolution procedure. No unilateral price adjustment is permitted.
edits.name: Purchase price counterproposal

edits.text: 2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur within thirty days of signing, on a date mutually agreed by the parties, subject to satisfaction or written waiver by the party entitled to the benefit of the relevant condition. Before signing, Buyer shall complete financial and legal diligence to its satisfaction and obtain its required internal approvals, and the parties shall agree the Purchase Price, applicable accounting standards and disclosure schedules. Closing conditions shall be: receipt of the required third-party and governmental consents specifically identified in an agreed schedule; delivery of instruments transferring the Shares free of encumbrances, together with any necessary releases effective at Closing; Seller's representations being accurate in all material respects at Closing, except representations expressly made as of an earlier date, which shall be tested as of that date, and representations already qualified by materiality, which shall be accurate as qualified; each party's performance in all material respects of its obligations required before Closing; and absence of any legal prohibition on the transaction. Payment of the Purchase Price, release of share encumbrances and delivery of the transfer instruments shall occur concurrently.
edits.name: Objective closing conditions

edits.text: 3. REPRESENTATIONS. Except as expressly disclosed in disclosure schedules agreed and delivered before signing, the Seller represents that the financial statements identified in those schedules fairly present, in all material respects, the financial position and results of operations of the business for the periods covered, in accordance with [ACCOUNTING STANDARD TO BE AGREED], consistently applied, subject to exceptions expressly identified in those schedules. Seller further represents that it owns the Shares, has authority to enter into and perform this Agreement, and will transfer good title to the Shares at Closing free of encumbrances. No disclosure schedule amendment after signing shall qualify a representation or limit Buyer's remedies without Buyer's written consent.
edits.name: Financial statements, title and authority

edits.text: 4. INDEMNITY. Seller shall indemnify Buyer for actual, direct losses arising from (a) breach of Seller's representations or covenants in this Agreement; (b) liabilities of the business existing before Closing that were neither reflected or reserved for in the financial statements nor expressly disclosed in the agreed disclosure schedules; and (c) taxes attributable to periods ending on or before Closing and the portion through Closing of any straddle period, except to the extent reflected in the Purchase Price or otherwise recovered by Buyer. Seller's aggregate liability under this clause shall not exceed 30% of the Purchase Price, except as expressly provided below. Claims must be notified in writing with reasonable particulars within twenty-four months after Closing. Claims for breach of title or authority representations and claims for pre-Closing taxes shall instead be subject to an aggregate cap equal to 100% of the Purchase Price, inclusive of amounts paid on other indemnity claims, and may be notified until sixty days after expiry of the applicable statutory limitation period. Claims for breach of a covenant expressly requiring performance after Closing may be notified until twelve months after the date performance is due, but remain subject to the general cap. Neither the contractual cap nor the contractual notification deadline applies to Seller's own fraud. A claim notified within the applicable period survives until finally resolved. Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate losses and shall not recover more than once for the same loss. Buyer shall promptly notify Seller of third-party claims; delay shall relieve Seller of liability only to the extent materially prejudiced. Seller may assume the defense with counsel reasonably acceptable to Buyer upon acknowledging its indemnity obligation, unless the claim involves a material conflict of interest, criminal allegations or material nonmonetary relief against Buyer. Buyer may participate with its own counsel at its own expense, except that reasonable separate counsel costs caused by a material conflict shall constitute indemnifiable losses. No settlement may bind Buyer without its prior written consent. Such consent shall not be unreasonably withheld where the settlement provides an unconditional release of Buyer, requires only monetary payment fully funded by Seller, and imposes no admission or other obligation on Buyer. Buyer shall not settle an indemnifiable claim without Seller's prior written consent, not to be unreasonably withheld.
edits.name: Indemnity counterproposal and claims procedure
